prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one LANDSCAPE production storyboard sheet with exactly FOUR equal 16:9 panels in a clean 2-by-2 grid, thin white gutters. Each panel is a single cinematic still, not multiple events. Use the attached named character masters as identity references and attached environments as layout references. Preserve faces, ages, clothing and relative heights. Original polished stylized 3D family animation. No speech balloons and no generated dialogue text. Small shot ID labels only at lower-left of each panel. Panels in reading order:
Panel 1, S33: Visible characters DAN. Medium Dan at counter; vendor stays off-screen; only hands may enter. Location: MARKET_CHECKOUT. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Sorted totes on checkout counter; total confirmed as $18.50; no payment yet.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Dan sets the blue and yellow totes on the checkout counter. The vendor weighs nothing in this count-priced example; a price graphic lists the scripted total. Dan asks clearly.
Panel 2, S34: Visible characters LEO, DAN. Medium two-shot with price display added in post. Location: MARKET_CHECKOUT. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Twenty-dollar payment on counter; wallet in Dan's hand; change not yet given.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Leo points to the total on a readable editorial price card. Dan takes one twenty-dollar bill from his wallet and places it flat on the counter.
Panel 3, S35: Visible characters DAN, MAX. Medium Dan and Max; vendor hands place receipt and change on counter. Location: MARKET_CHECKOUT. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Receipt, one dollar bill and two quarters received; no extra money appears.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): The vendor gives Dan one dollar and two quarters plus a receipt. Max looks down at his green shirt when he hears change, prompting a gentle joke.
Panel 4, S36: Visible characters DAN, LEO. Close two-shot, receipt held between them; text composited in post. Location: MARKET_CHECKOUT. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Receipt and change safely in wallet; payment complete; ready to carry bags home.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Leo checks the receipt. Dan stores it and the change in his wallet, then pockets the wallet. Both notes remain clipped to the matching totes.
Keep blue and yellow list papers BLANK for later exact editorial text. Never draw invented food labels or duplicate blue-list contents on yellow paper. Each selected vegetable exists once; if it has been placed in the basket, it is no longer also in a hand or on the counter. Unpurchased crate stock is separate. Exact quantities apply only to selected produce. Use unobtrusive background blur for stock. The source images in order are: DAN, LEO, MAX, MARKET_CHECKOUT. Select ONLY the named cast for each panel; a lineup source does not mean all people appear in every panel. Do not merge people, duplicate a cast member in a panel, change clothes or invent an extra child. Storyboard only; no claim of animated video.
Exact visual staging: Both full totes always stand on counter with contents below rims; one blue note clipped to blue handle and one yellow note clipped to yellow handle. S33 no money on counter. S34 exactly one illustrated twenty-dollar bill flat on counter, Dan holds wallet; no coins. S35 exactly one one-dollar bill and TWO silver quarter coins plus ONE narrow blank receipt strip on counter; old twenty no longer visible; vendor's single hand at far edge only, vendor face/body absent; Max glances at green shirt. S36 is the ENDING pose: wallet already pocketed, hands empty, no receipt or coins on counter. Crop if necessary but no extra money. Price card blank for exact SVG overlay later. Reference checkout register right, green hanging plant above right, red cream striped awning. Dan watch anatomical LEFT wrist. 2048x1152 landscape.
